name: Lacey Mallet
source:
Occupation: Diva
Hobbies: Singing
Skills: Singing
Likes: Her own song
Dislikes: Tone-deafness

A famous singer who has both a beautiful personality and beautiful appearance. She doesn't sing because of the money but rather lives by her motto, "I was born to sing". She entered Closed GAME in order to prove that her songs would become hits even in the celestial world.
